description.value: St. Lawrence is a Michelin-starred restaurant on Powell Street in Vancouver's Gastown neighbourhood, blending classic French technique with the culinary traditions of Québec under Chef/Owner Jean-Christophe Poirier. Opened in 2017, it has earned placement on Canada's 100 Best Restaurants list multiple years running and was named to the World's 50 Best Discovery List. The experience centres on a four-course table d'hôte menu with a rotating seasonal focus, currently drawing inspiration from Provence.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms the OSM address, phone, and URL, and provides rich detail about the restaurant's concept and accolades. No cycling-specific amenities (bike rack, takeout, water refill, washrooms) are mentioned anywhere on the website or in the OSM tags. The /reserve subpage makes clear this is a reservation-based fine-dining dinner venue with limited walk-in options, which limits its practical utility for a touring cyclist stopping mid-ride.
concerns: OSM opening_hours tag lists Tu-Sa; website footer shows Tuesday-Sunday — minor discrepancy worth verifying.
This is a reservation-based fine-dining dinner venue; walk-in access is limited to bar seats, reducing spontaneous cyclist utility.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: St. Lawrence is a notable destination restaurant that a touring cyclist might plan a visit around, but no required WWC criteria (bike parking/visibility, water refill, washrooms) can be confirmed from the website or OSM tags. A site visit is needed to verify whether any cycling-friendly amenities exist before listing.
enrichment_extras.notes: The restaurant has a sister location, Chez Céline, in Vancouver's Fraserhood (Fraser & 27th), which could be a separate candidate entry.
